data.one_liner: A two-dimensional table widget with both sticky headers and a sticky legend cell.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to display a two-dimensional grid of data where both the top row and left column headers remain visible during horizontal and vertical scrolling. The cells are fully customizable using widget builders.
use_when: You need to display tabular data with fixed headers that do not scroll out of view
You require custom widgets and interactions inside table cells
avoid_when: You need a simple vertical-only list or standard data table without a sticky top header and sticky left column
strengths: Both top and left headers always stay visible while scrolling in any direction
Fully customizable cell contents, dimensions, alignments, and tap handlers
Supports custom scroll controllers and initial scroll offsets
weaknesses: The project is currently in support-only mode
Custom scroll controllers require manual disposal by the developer to avoid leaks
data.minimal_example:
StickyHeadersTable(
  columnsLength: titleColumn.length,
  rowsLength: titleRow.length,
  columnsTitleBuilder: (i) => Text(titleColumn[i]),
  rowsTitleBuilder: (i) => Text(titleRow[i]),
  contentCellBuilder: (i, j) => Text(data[i][j]),
  legendCell: Text('Sticky Legend'),
)
